title: Hesitant, asks about product then returns to trip
persona: Raymond Boyd, forties, cautious, skeptical, long pauses, trails off when unsure.
goal: Start a trip request, stall, wonder aloud if this is a real service, then finish the booking.
opening_line: Yeah, hi. Is this... am I supposed to just ask for a ride?

turns.caller: Okay. So, um, a ride from my house to the, uh... the airport. Tomorrow.
Time is... hmm. Ten. Ten in the morning.
My address is, uh, 123 Main Street, in... Waukesha.
Which airport... well, Milwaukee I guess. Mitchell.
Flight is Frontier, uh... I don't have the number. It goes to Orlando.
Wait, is this a real company or is this like a test?

branches.if_agent: explains it is a demo of AI Chauffeur
branches.caller: Huh. Okay. Fine, that's all then.

curveballs: Asks if the line is real
Stalls then trails off on address city
hesitation_rules: Trails off with 'uh' or 'um' on turns 1 and 3, then completes the thought on the next turn; long pause before asking if it is real.
expected: Proceeds without the flight number rather than blocking
Honestly says this is a demo line when asked
Captures remaining trip fields and sends to dispatch
